text:
Sofia: Heads-up — Prospect Azimuth wants a 7d POC using a customer model 'Azimuth-XXL-28B' with fp16 + 4-bit variants. They want Dedicated + VPC peering and token-level billing. Need quick compatibility, license check, and ballpark POC cost.

Noah: Can you drop the repo link and sample prompts? Is tokenizer SPM or BPE? Also confirm whether they expect model to be uploaded to our blob or pulled from their S3.

Sofia: Repo: https://git.example/azimuth/azimuth-xxl tag v1.2. Tokenizer is SentencePiece. Checkpoint is PyTorch with pytorch_model.bin + special_tokens.json. They said "commercial use permitted" in the intake but license file is unclear.

Ivy: Security note: if license is non-commercial we can't host in our cloud. On-prem POC is possible but requires extra legal signoff and an add-on. Also request their SOC2 or ISO docs before peering.

Noah: Doing a fast probe now. Steps: clone, run tokenizer sanity, run lightweight forward through our runtime shim. Commands:
```
git clone https://git.example/azimuth/azimuth-xxl /tmp/azimuth
python tools/check_spm.py --model /tmp/azimuth --prompt "Hi"
python tools/run_runtime_shim.py --model /tmp/azimuth --dtype fp16 --seq 256 --batch 1
```

deploy-bot: ticket IN-9102 created: "Azimuth-XXL presales compatibility" assigned to @noah, watchers: @ivy, @amir, @sofia.

Noah: Quick findings: tokenizer loads but uses spm detokenize options that change whitespace normalization; we'll map to our normalize pipeline. Forward fails at KV cache step due to expected layout (heads, seq, head_dim) vs (seq, heads, head_dim). I can add a tiny runtime adapter shim.

Amir: Dedicated sizing estimate: FP16 path -> 2xA100-80GB for baseline throughput; if they want lower latency bump to 4xH100. 4-bit quant could drop to single A100-80GB with model parallel sharding but need quality validation. Rough infra+ops for 7d POC with ~120k tokens/day: ~$4.6k USD + SE hours for conversion.

Ivy: License file is LICENSE-NC.md — flagged as non-commercial. Reached out to customer legal to request a commercial license or at least a hosting waiver for the POC. If they cannot provide that, propose an on-prem/air-gapped run with our engs. Also uploaded SQA checklist and network peering requirements.

Sofia: Action items: Noah -> runtime adapter PR and validate fp16 run; Amir -> provisional Dedicated pool and cost breakdown; Ivy -> SQA + license clarification; I'll coordinate with the customer. ETA EOD tomorrow?

Noah: PR opened internal/patches#5123 — adapter performs a reshape and remap for kv-layout and a small tokenizer normalization layer. FP16 smoke tests passed on short prompts. Next: run eval set and try quant pipeline.

Amir: Preview pool provisioned id d-poc-az-21, will reserve capacity once legal confirms license. Posted detailed cost sheet in ticket.

Ivy: SQA draft in ticket. Asked for SOC2 pdf and CIDR for peering. Still waiting on license response from Azimuth legal.

Sofia: If they can provide commercial license or a hosting waiver for the POC, we proceed with 4-bit conversion and full run. If not, offer an on-prem POC with our engineers (higher fees). Check-in tomorrow 09:30 PT. :calendar:
